judgment: Holding firm, with an elder in charge:
image: So the noble one makes room for the people
lines: The army marches out in order;
He is in the midst of the army:
Three times the king gives him the charge.
The army camps to the left.
There is game in the field; it is good to seize it, and speak out.
The eldest leads the army, but the younger carts corpses.
The great ruler gives the charge:
to open states and receive houses.
But do not use the small person.

notes.name_en: 師 is the host on campaign; plain 'Army'.
notes.judgment: 丈人 the elder (senior commander), kept distinct from 大人.
notes.L5: 執言 'seize and speak' (take the prisoner and hear him); compressed, both halves kept.
